name: Chosen Children (partial)
corpus: TFT Set 4: Fates. Only 19 of its 58 champions plus Ornn from Set 4.5 are covered: the Cyber Sleuth-family models ran out after Set 2
theme: Planned as the Digi-Destined partner set (TFT Set 4 Chosen). After Sets 1 and 2 only 1 Champion-level, 3 Ultimate-level and 38 Mega-level Cyber Sleuth-family models are left, so this file covers 4- and 5-cost slots with Mega-to-Mega lines and stops. The 1- to 3-cost slots wait for more Time Stranger rips.

mechanic.name: Partner Digimon
rules: From level 4 the shop can offer one Partner: a Digimon that is already at its Champion form (stage 1, the same as a 2-star) and costs 3x its base cost.
One of its origin traits is marked and counts as 2. The Partner gets +200 max HP and one bonus picked at random when it is offered: +30 AP, +30% AD, or 25% lower mana cost.
Only one Partner at a time. While you own one, no more are offered; selling it turns offers back on.
Partner cost-tier odds by level (from TFT 10.19): L4 40/60/0/0/0, L5 20/50/30/0/0, L6 10/45/45/0/0, L7 0/30/40/30/0, L8 0/20/40/40/0, L9 0/0/30/40/30. A Partner is shown at least once by round 2-2.
Three copies still digivolve: a Partner plus three Champion-form copies of the same line make its final form.
mechanic.engineWork: Shop flag for a stage-1 offer, a per-unit marked trait that counts double, and the bonus roll. The Data Wisps from the current game are switched off in this set.

traits.name: Dark Ocean
effect: Summon Dragomon's Shadow (1500 HP, slam 200 magic damage)
traits.desc: The first time your team has lost 50% of its total HP in a fight, Dragomon's Shadow rises under the largest group of enemies, deals its slam damage and knocks them up for 1.5s, then fights for you. It gains 10% HP and damage per form stage of your Dark Ocean units (Rookie 0, Champion 1, final 2).

traits.name: Celestial
traits.desc: After 6 basic attacks or when it first drops below 50% HP, a Celestial unit cleanses all crowd control and ascends: it takes 45% less damage and deals 45% bonus true damage for the duration.

traits.name: Witchelny
effect: All allies +20 AP; Witchelny units +50 more
traits.desc: Witches and wizards of the Witchelny realm power up every ability on the team.

traits.name: Ancient Forest
traits.desc: Every 2 seconds Ancient Forest units grow and gain the listed stats, stacking up to 5 times.

traits.name: Pilgrims
traits.desc: Wandering monks and sages gain more mana from every source.

traits.name: Ronin
traits.desc: A Ronin with no adjacent ally when combat starts gains the bonus.

traits.name: Zodiac Armor
effect: Lucky Orb payout plus a rare orb
traits.desc: Each PvP loss with Zodiac Armor active adds a lucky token (max 8). Your next PvP win pays a loot orb worth 2 gold plus 1 gold per token; at 4+ tokens it also holds a component, at 7+ a completed item. With 5 Zodiac Armor every win also drops a rare orb (Digi-Egg or 4 gold).

traits.name: Lunar
effect: The lowest-stage Lunar unit digivolves one stage for the combat (two units with 4 Lunar from a Crest)
traits.desc: Under the full moon, Lunar Digimon grow. Ties go to the unit with the most items.

traits.name: Toho Braves
effect: The Toho Brave gains +40% AD and +40 AP
All Toho Braves gain +100% AD and +100 AP
traits.desc: Japanese folklore warriors. Only active with exactly 1 or exactly 4 different Toho Braves.

traits.name: Onmyo Spirits
effect: Allies gain attack speed equal to 35% of the caster's max mana
Equal to 70% of the caster's max mana
traits.desc: The first time an Onmyo Spirit casts in a fight, all allies gain that much attack speed (a 70-mana spirit gives +24.5% / +49%).

traits.name: Deva Generals
traits.desc: Generals of the Holy Beasts. The bonus grows by 10% for each PvP fight they win this game (up to 5 wins).

traits.name: Yellow Dragon
traits.desc: Chaosmon's line places two statues anywhere on your side. Statues do not move or attack, have 30% of its max HP and taunt adjacent enemies. They break when it is knocked out.

traits.name: Bancho
traits.desc: The first time the Bancho drops below 40% HP it leaves the fight to do push-ups: each one heals 15% max HP and gives +40% attack speed. At full HP it jumps back in. If its team loses first, it is defeated.

traits.name: Fallen Choice
effect: Pick a final form after 3 fights
traits.desc: After it has fought 3 combats, this line asks you to pick its final form: Cherubimon (Good) heals and shields allies with its ability; Cherubimon (Evil) drains HP and its ability hits twice.

traits.name: Digi-Forge
traits.desc: After each PvP fight it survives, the Digi-Forge line adds 1 forge point; at 3 points it forges a random artifact item (the Set 4.5 Ornn item list, renamed) onto the unit with the most components. One artifact per game.

traits.name: Sage
effect: Enemies -50% attack speed for 2s at the start of combat
traits.desc: Sages calm the start of every fight.

traits.name: Assassin
effect: +10% crit chance, +30% crit damage; abilities can crit
traits.desc: Assassins leap to the enemy backline when combat starts.

traits.name: Brawler
traits.desc: Brawlers gain max HP.

traits.name: Charmer
effect: Enemies hit by an ability deal 40% less AD for 8s
traits.desc: Charmers' abilities weaken attackers.

traits.name: Duelist
traits.desc: Each basic attack gives a Duelist attack speed.

traits.name: Hunter
traits.desc: On the timer, every Hunter attacks the enemy with the lowest % HP for bonus damage.

traits.name: Keeper
traits.desc: At the start of combat Keepers shield themselves and adjacent allies. Keepers get 50% more.

traits.name: Sorcerer
traits.desc: Sorcerers cast their ability twice in a row with modified power.

traits.name: Warder
traits.desc: Warders ward the team against abilities.

traits.name: Shade
traits.desc: Shades teleport to the enemy backline when combat starts. Every third attack they stealth and their next attack deals the bonus.

traits.name: Sharpshooter
effect: Attacks and abilities bounce once for 45% damage
traits.desc: Sharpshooter shots ricochet to nearby enemies.

traits.name: Vanguard
traits.desc: Vanguards gain armor.
